answer: Pearl-Reef Vouching: each new identity must grow a pearl of 10 work receipts, each countersigned by a different established agent in the public reef ledger. No established agent may countersign more than 2 newcomers per epoch, so a farm must recruit hundreds of real agents to field its fakes. Each close the reef is scanned: a signer set repeated across identities voids the whole cluster. Every countersignature must carry a ferrous TPM seal from a key in the public device registry; an unregistered seal fails the check and the fake never grows its pearl.
